fills.researcher_notes: Investigated the brief's second lead: this row shares the 'MP 59.91' milepost with P4138 (MP 59.91-Nandipur Power Plant Gas Pipeline), which I resolved to StartYear1=2017 off strong 2017 Nandipur gas-conversion coverage (Wikipedia, naturalgasworld.com, The Nation, Gasco Engineering). I checked whether that same 2017 project extends back to Head Balloki: the 2017 press (naturalgasworld.com, nsenergybusiness.com, dailyparliamenttimes.com) describes an ~88km pipeline supplying Nandipur but none names Head Balloki as the supply origin or gives a route/origin point at all -- the reporting is uniformly plant-side (Nandipur/Gujranwala), not source-side. 'Head Balloki' itself (most likely referencing the Balloki headworks on the Ravi, a known place name in this corridor) returns no gas-pipeline hits in DuckDuckGo/Bing beyond generic dictionary/anatomy noise for 'head' + irrelevant sports-equipment results -- the search terms are too generic to disambiguate. I did not find independent confirmation that P4141 is part of the 2017 Nandipur project, so I have NOT extended the P4138 date to this row -- that would be an unsupported inference, and the brief's shared-milepost observation only tells us these rows came off the same class of SNGPL engineering document, not that they were built in the same year. Leaving StartYear1 blank.

validity.recommendation: Do not fill StartYear1 from this alone -- it is corridor-adjacency reasoning, not a named date. Worth a human pulling SNGPL's OGRA licence schedule or an EPC contract for this specific segment, since it sits directly on the delivery path to the confirmed-2017 Nandipur spur.
validity.researcher_notes: SNGPL Annual Report 2018 asset register (pages 32-35, https://www.sngpl.com.pk/download/AnnualReport-2018/SNGPLAR-2018.pdf) lists row 144 'D/S HEAD BALLOKI TO MP-59.9 / 18in / loopline 52.34 km' -- an EXACT match to this row's Diameter and LengthKnown, confirming spec accuracy (same finding applies to every row in this brief). Beyond the spec match: this segment sits in a cluster of adjoining loopline rows (143: Phool Nagar-U/S Head Balloki 18in/10.38km; 144: this row; 146: Phoolnagar-Dawood Hercules 24in/65.47km; 147: 'U/S V/A HEAD BALLOKI TO D/S V/A HEAD BALLOKI (RLNG LINE)' 24in/3.10km) where row 147 is EXPLICITLY tagged '(RLNG LINE)' in SNGPL's own register -- i.e. built as part of the 2015-2017 RLNG-import augmentation program (the same program SNGPL's milestone timeline dates 'PROJECT X PHASE IV' to, which by name serves Bhikki/Balloki/Haveli Bahadur Shah/Nandipur power plants). Since this row (144) runs D/S of Head Balloki straight to MP 59.91 -- the exact junction that feeds onward to the confirmed-2017 Nandipur spur (P4138, row 129 of the same register) -- it is plausible this segment belongs to the same RLNG-era build-out. I am NOT treating that as sourced enough to fill StartYear1: it is inferred from physical/tabular adjacency, not a document that names this segment's date, and the protocol is explicit that shared milepost/tabular grouping is not itself a date. Flagging for a human with access to OGRA's licence-schedule filings (which the brief names as a promising but 403-blocked lead) to check directly.
